title: Another tab's busy post does not say which chat asked; dots show in a mirrored New chat
evidence: Owner UI. Fable ruled R7 (b) 2026-11-12 on the chat-turn reducer: slice 2 limits the US-15 AC7a amendment to the tab that asked. Other tabs still draw the dots from othersBusy (useChatBusy) under whatever chat they show, so tab 1 sends, then New chat, and tab 2 mirrors the new chat with dots for the length of the reply. Fix (R7 a): each busy post carries the sender's asked key, the mirror carries its shown key, and dots draw only where they match; older bundles fall back to today. Its own slice after slice 4 (widget-src/src/hooks/useChatState.ts `replying`, lib/chat-sync.ts).
